key_insight: InfiniteWeb automatically synthesizes realistic, multi-page, functional web environments at scale so GUI agents can be trained and evaluated on diverse, interactive websites rather than isolated single-page samples.
problem_solved: Addresses the scarcity and low realism of training environments for GUI agents — LLMs can draft single pages but struggle to generate coherent, stateful, interconnected websites at the scale and diversity needed for robust agent training and evaluation.
method: Hybrid generation pipeline: combine LLM-driven content/layout generation with procedural scaffolding to produce multi-page site skeletons and link graphs.
Behavioral instrumentation: attach scripted, stateful component behaviors and automated validations (e.g., headless-browser checks) to ensure interactivity and correctness.
Scaling & diversity: use templates, parameterization, and automated variation to produce large numbers of distinct, realistic websites for training and benchmarking.
impact: Provides scalable, realistic synthetic web environments that reduce manual data creation, enable broader and more robust GUI agent training, and create standardized benchmarks for agent evaluation.

paper_title: InfiniteWeb: Scalable Web Environment Synthesis for GUI Agent Training
paper_authors: Ziyun Zhang, Zezhou Wang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zongyu Guo, Jiahao Li
